notes.4: The solution to this question revolves around the dates given. The old motor vehicle was sold and the new one purchased on 1 September 2020. The year end of the business was 31 December 2020. The transfer of depreciation to the disposal account would have been made on 1 September 2020. However, the provision for depreciation of the new vehicle would not have been recorded until 31 December 2020, giving the key D.
